title: Emrys and the Choir
author: Silas Zhou
blurb: Ivo Whitlock, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
